name: Dagger
overview: The dagger, described as a short sword about a cubit in length, is vividly illustrated in the account of Ehud in Judges 3:16-21. This weapon was concealed under Ehud's garment and used with precision and secrecy to deliver a decisive blow to King Eglon of Moab, demonstrating its role not only as a tool of combat but also of divine judgment. The narrative highlights the dagger's significance in God's deliverance of Israel through unexpected means, emphasizing the careful preparation and courage involved in carrying out God's will.
